timeline.summary: Sanjay Chougule, Promoter of Indo Amines Limited, declared holding 11,808 (0.02%) shares as of March 31, 2026, with no new encumbrances.

Techno Holdings (India) Private Limited, via **Bhalchandra Bhalchandra Palkar**, declared no encumbrance on its 10.74% stake in Indo Amines Limited as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Palkar Commercials Private Limited, on behalf of Indo Amines Limited’s promoter group, declared 40,70,000 (5.61%) equity shares held as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances during FY2025-26.

Techno Securities (India) Private Limited, as part of Indo Amines Limited’s promoter group, declared its 11.52% shareholding (83,63,920 equity shares) unchanged with no encumbrances for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹317.61 Cr (+11.3% YoY), net profit ₹20.51 Cr (+73.1% YoY).
Bharati Vijay Palkar, Promoter of Indo Amines Limited, disclosed holding 52,24,204 (7.20%) equity shares as of March 31, 2026, with no new encumbrances created.
MPCB grants conditional restart for Indo Amines' Mahad unit, excluding TBU
On 22 October 2026, Indo Amines disclosed that the Maharashtra GST Department initiated inspection and search proceedings at its registered office.
Maharashtra GST department concluded search and inspection proceedings initiated on 22 October 2026 under Section 67 across Indo Amines' Maharashtra premises without material impact.
